name: ZocDoc New Patient Booking
description: Process Zocdoc NEW-patient bookings: fee call-request, EMA portal, welcome SMS. Messaging and calls attach as correlation hooks (not full workers here).

rules: Same id on every report_process upsert (running → completed/failed/dead_letter)
Never put correlation_id in patient-facing SMS body
Weave breadcrumb: relatedIds plain string only
Hooks attach to same root correlation_id + step/hook name (no second root id)

aliases_also_accepted.action: same as name or human label

gates.name: already_processed
gates.description: Skip patient if completed execution exists for correlation_id (unless --force; force still honors step_done)

gates.name: already_contacted
gates.description: Skip SMS if Genie $100 / welcome template fingerprint already present (honored even with --force)

gates.name: portal_already_active
gates.description: Skip portal activate if EMA patient.username already set

gates.name: call_already_requested
gates.description: Skip call-request if patient.requestedToCallTimestamp set or step_done(call)

steps.name: get_booking_details
steps.description: Pull appointment + requestId + PHI needed for side effects; report GB running

on_failure.retry: next cron / manual re-run same correlation_id
on_failure.dead_letter_when: auth permanently broken after N operator attempts

steps.name: send_call_request
steps.description: Zocdoc 'call the office' request — $100 fee avoidance within 24h of booking
steps.report_action_label: Sent call office request on ZocDoc
steps.note: $100 fee gate — must succeed or skip-as-already before portal/SMS

on_failure.retry: re-run; do not proceed to portal/SMS until done/skipped
on_failure.dead_letter_when: booking >24h old and fee already charged / request impossible; or permanent missing requestId after chart review
on_failure.next_action: check Zocdoc requestId / Kernel auth; do not force-retry until ledger/GB shows step 2 done

steps.name: activate_portal
steps.description: EMA portal activate / portal email; omit cellPhone (500 if included)

on_failure.retry: next re-entry if still not username-set
on_failure.dead_letter_when: never alone — does not block completion if call+SMS ok
on_failure.note: Portal failure is recorded as step failed/skipped but does not fail the whole job if call_request + SMS succeed

steps.name: send_welcome_sms
steps.description: Template-only welcome SMS (Genie - New Zocdoc Patient); correlation_id in relatedIds only

on_failure.dead_letter_when: no phone on booking after operator chart fix attempts exhausted
on_failure.next_action: check Weave auth / phone; do not resend until ledger step 4 done or fingerprint present

steps.name: report_completed
steps.description: Final report_process completed (or failed/dead_letter) with full steps blob

on_failure.execution_status: may leave running if GB write fails after side effects
on_failure.retry: re-run; side effects skipped via step_done → re-report completed

hooks.name: messaging_inbound
hooks.description: Attach inbound SMS/thread events to the NP execution for ops visibility (not implemented in zocdoc-new-booking job).

contract.trigger: inbound Weave message on thread linked to NP SMS
contract.job_action: append step or activity only — do not re-run fee/SMS path

report.preferred: log_activity action=weave_inbound_correlated payload={correlation_id, threadId, direction:inbound, status}

optional_step.name: messaging_inbound_observed
optional_step.detail: inbound reply observed (no body in GB)

failure.unmatched_inbound: no execution update; optional needs_review queue outside this flow

non_goals: Full messaging worker / auto-reply engine in this definition

hooks.name: calls_outbound
hooks.description: Correlate outbound Weave/Genie calls (FD follow-up) to the NP booking execution.

match_order: Caller passes correlation_id into dial metadata / GB activity

contract.trigger: outbound dial related to NP onboarding (card-on-file / confirm)
contract.job_action: record outcome on same execution; never send_call_request again

report.preferred: log_activity action=weave_call_outbound payload={correlation_id, call_record_id, disposition, status}

optional_step.name: calls_outbound_observed
optional_step.detail: disposition only — no recording URL with PHI in public UI

failure.dial_failed: activity failed; execution stays completed if NP path done
failure.retry: new dial attempt; new activity row; bump metadata only

hooks.name: calls_inbound
hooks.description: Correlate inbound patient calls (post call-the-office request) to the NP execution.

match_order: Caller-ID last10 vs booking phone_last4 + open NP executions
Zocdoc call-request window (bookingTime + 24h) as soft filter

contract.trigger: inbound call answered/missed while NP execution open or recently completed
contract.job_action: observe only; fee path already handled by send_call_request step

report.preferred: log_activity action=weave_call_inbound payload={correlation_id, call_record_id, disposition, status}

failure.unmatched_inbound: no auto-link; do not invent correlation_id

non_goals: Auto-cancel Zocdoc booking from call disposition without human/policy job

failure_matrix.how: Re-run job same correlation_id (cron or CLI). step_done skips finished steps.

failure_matrix.execution_status: failed → dead_letter after chart review if unrecoverable
failure_matrix.how: Fix booking data or mark dead_letter + metadata.dead_letter=true

failure_matrix.condition: Call-request failed; fee window still open
failure_matrix.how: Priority retry; do not run portal/SMS until step 2 done/skipped
Non-fatal; re-entry may retry portal if username still empty

failure_matrix.operator: retry then dead_letter if no phone
failure_matrix.how: Fingerprint + ledger prevent double-SMS on success path
--force re-enters but still skips done steps and Weave fingerprint
Bottle UI filter (t_0c1b4cdc); optional feedback webhook needs_review

failure_matrix.condition: Hook worker cannot match inbound message/call
failure_matrix.how: Do not invent correlation_id; leave unmatched

steps_min.name: send_call_request
steps_min.action: Sent call office request on ZocDoc

schedule.live_gate: Barric go-live + GENIE_BOTTLE_API_KEY + auth; cron flag default OFF
